control_variation.evidence: 3 macros, all claims PASS. brightness sweep: centroid 855 -> 1.52k -> 1.81k Hz, a real effect. busyness sweep: crest 19.9 -> 16.6 -> 16.4 dB, peak -1.0 -> -4.3 -> -4.6 dBFS, a real effect (the onset count stays at 62-63, saturated). wash: 0 -> 0.5 -> 1 leaves centroid, bands and flatness identical to 2 decimals (flatness 0.00 at every step, so the PASS is on tiny numbers); only onsets 62 -> 56 and pitch changed, so the knob is almost inert. notes: The wash (noise bed) knob does almost nothing audible by measurement: flatness stays about 0.000 and the bands do not move.
Seed 3's peak is at 0.36 s and seed 1's at 2.91 s (momentary variation), but the LUFS curve is flat so this is fine; seed 2 DC is -101 dB, still far under the limit.

Detected onsets saturate at about 15 per second (busyness 1 = 63 onsets, same as 0.5), so the onset detector cannot show how dense the bubbles really are; busyness 0.5 to 1 is only visible in crest and swing.
